svg.aria-label: Diagram of the Fireguard modelling work. One: yearly hotspot counts jump in 2012 when VIIRS replaces MODIS, and harmonization factors lift the MODIS years to one continuous scale, with a yearly-total error of 2.1 percent in Argentina and 5.3 percent in Chile on held-out years. Two: 23 features per cell-day feed one LightGBM model per country, with a SHAP reason for every alert. Three: a risk map for the next day. On 2023 to 2025, unseen in training, it catches 78.0 percent of fire cell-days in Argentina and 79.1 percent in Chile, against 64 and 49 percent for the neighbour rule at the same alert budget.
